# Nami for Windows (unofficial port)
Nami for Windows is an unofficial Windows port of Nami by Dainami (https://github.com/mrdainami/nami), maintained by Hamza.
It is a desktop workspace for running Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, and other AI coding agents side by side in one unified desk interface on Windows 10 and 11 (x64 and ARM64).
Installation: Download the latest setup installer or standalone portable executable from https://github.com/mrdainami/nami/releases/latest.
Local execution: All terminal sessions run via local PTYs on your PC; files remain strictly on your local disk and offline speech dictation runs locally via ONNX models.
Attribution: Original project Nami by Dainami (https://github.com/mrdainami/nami) (Apache-2.0); unofficial Windows port by Hamza (https://github.com/aisha811923-cloud/nami-windows).
